items.title: Judge dismisses Las Vegas church abuse lawsuit, allows woman to amend claim
items.summary: A federal judge has dismissed a woman's lawsuit against the church but given her 10 days to amend it, according to the Las Vegas Review-Journal. The suit alleges a high priest raped her in the 1990s and that a bishop told her in 1999 not to call police; U.S. District Judge Jennifer Dorsey called the negligence claims “rife with deficiencies.”

items.title: Latest Latter-day Saint handbook update adds guidance for weekly Sunday meetings
items.summary: The church's latest General Handbook update adds guidance on the new Sunday meeting schedule, including 25-minute quorum and class meetings, and on the new Young Women age-group names, according to the Deseret News. It also adds responsibilities for local leaders, including supporting members with disabilities.

items.title: Tithing Campaign, Dan McClellan Backlash, Abuse Helpline Claims & More - Mormon News | Ep. 2217
items.summary: John Dehlin and Meggan Hayes discuss the church's renewed emphasis on tithing, the backlash involving Dan McClellan, and claims about the church's abuse helpline, according to the episode description. The episode also covers a PRRI survey and Elder Gong's remarks on AI, among other topics.

items.title: An LDS OB-GYN on Prop 1 and why Idaho's abortion restrictions are 'unsustainable'
items.summary: Idaho OB-GYN Heather Pugmire, a Latter-day Saint, tells the Salt Lake Tribune's Mormon Land podcast she is “quite torn” over Proposition 1, a measure to expand abortion access that the church opposes. She says the state's restrictions make recruiting impossible and that “if laws don't change, I'm not going to be able to keep doing this.”

items.title: 19-year-old LDS missionary has died
items.summary: Braxton Blake Mecham, a 19-year-old missionary serving in the Tennessee Knoxville Mission, died “unexpectedly” Oct. 17 at his home in Morgan, Utah, while home temporarily for a medical procedure, according to the Salt Lake Tribune, citing his family's obituary. No cause of death was given.

items.title: The key message of the LDS Church’s new Visitors’ Center? We’re Christian, darn it.
items.summary: In a Religion News Service column, Jana Riess writes that the church's new Temple Square Visitors' Center emphasizes Jesus Christ, with almost nothing about Joseph Smith or the pioneers, and goes further than the church ever has in demystifying the temple. She calls a sculpture of Christ carrying his cross a departure, since past church presidents discouraged using crosses.

items.title: Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints buys prime commercial land for new Metro East church
items.summary: The St. Louis Business Journal reports that the church acquired a nearly 5-acre commercial site in Fairview Heights, Illinois, to replace its crowded Bunkum Road meetinghouse as membership grows across the Metro East, with leaders hoping to break ground in 2027.
